top_signals.title: Nigeria Eyes $50 Billion From 22 Offshore Oil and Gas Projects
top_signals.summary: Nigeria expects to attract investments worth between $30 billion and $50 billion from 22 offshore oil and gas projects over the nest five years, the country’s Upstream Petroleum Regulatory Commission has said. “Beyond increasing production, these investments will create jobs, expand infrastructure, strengthen energy security and reinforce Nigeria’s position as a leading global upstream investment destination,” the regulator’s chief executive Oritsemeyiwa Eyesan said, as quoted by The Sun. “Since 2024, the NUPRC…

top_signals.title: Asian tech stocks drop with SK Hynix plunging 10% after Wall Street AI names fall
top_signals.summary: Despite heightened volatility analysts remain optimistic over the outlook of the tech sector, with J.P. Morgan saying the tech sell-off had not derailed the AI investment cycle.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Coldcard hackers transfer 64 BTC and 200 ETH to cryptocurrency mixers
top_signals.summary: Hackers behind the Coldcard exploit transferred millions in digital assets to cryptocurrency mixers, while most stolen funds remained traceable in attacker-controlled wallets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Free Markets and Innovation, Sort Of
Japanese businesses brace for tax cut
top_signals.summary: Restaurant operators are poised to expand take-home meals, such as bento boxed meals and other precooked dishes, to cope with a wider tax gap between eat-in meals and takeout.
